task.description: Release gate for run TRANSL-20261025-01 (translation of Sai instruction files into English, decisions/0080). Verify yourself, do not trust the step reports. The originals are in the git tag base/TRANSL-20261025-01 (use a fresh git clone of the tag outside the project; never checkout/reset/stash/clean in the project). For every file in your scope compare the English text with the original section by section: (a) no rule, number, condition, name, step, example or cross reference is lost, added or changed in meaning (read, not only count); (b) headings, list items, table rows and code blocks match in number and order; (c) every identifier, AP/REQ/ISS number, decision number, command, field name and role code is unchanged (script the comparison); (d) Cyrillic that remains is only an intentional quotation with an English gloss (list every Russian passage longer than one line that is NOT a quotation or a placeholder); (e) the English is plain and consistent with the glossary in decisions/0080 item 5; (f) front matter of role files has name: in the form "Sai <Role> (CODE)" and the handoff command still accepts every role code. Report findings with the exact file and place in result.issues; do not edit project files, only your own handoff. Scope: docs/quality-bar.md, docs/anti-patterns.md (123 records: check every one), CLAUDE.md, README.md (merged content of the removed README.en.md and docs/agents.en.md: check nothing important is lost; get the removed files from the tag), tools/README.md; and the 37 re-pointed tests of step 06 (git diff of tools/test): each test must check the same fact as before and not be weaker; in particular FS-16 and the negative checks that now name only old Russian phrases — decide if they are still a real guard, and say what to do. Also run cd tools && npm run check yourself: only the 11 known reds (HO-46, HO-47, HC-RT-1e, LG-10c, SF-6c, SU-10, SU-11, SV-1f, SV-7e, TR-4b, TR-4e) are allowed.

result.summary: Verdict FAIL. Scope: docs/quality-bar.md, docs/anti-patterns.md (all 123 records), CLAUDE.md, README.md (merge of README.en.md and docs/agents.en.md), tools/README.md and the 37 re-pointed tests of step 06, each compared with the original in a fresh clone of the tag base/TRANSL-20261025-01 (<scratch>/clone-07c). Result in plain words: the translation is faithful. I read all 123 anti-pattern records next to the originals, the whole quality bar, the whole CLAUDE.md, the whole README.md against README.md + README.en.md + the head of agents.en.md, and checked tools/README.md by paragraph (14 sections, 430 old paragraphs = 430 new paragraphs after removing glosses), by numbers, by backticked tokens and by sentence count, plus side-by-side reading of the sections 'Check', 'handoffs-check' and the masking rules M7-M9. No rule, number, condition, step or example is lost, added or reversed in meaning. Two real defects block: (F1) the negative guard of FS-16 can no longer see the same fact in English (proved by a mutation on a copy), (F2) three identifiers written with Cyrillic letters were turned into Latin ones, so their cross references no longer find the target (AP-015 D7, AP-068 F7, AP-059 WEB-15 (b)). Six Low remarks do not block. Criteria of the task: (a) meaning - met, nothing lost or reversed; additions: AP-079 note on the old Russian test words, AP-102 note on the removed README.en.md, the paragraph in anti-patterns.md that explains why the four field names stay Russian, the last paragraph of README.md - all are explanations and change no rule; (b) structure - met: anti-patterns 126 headings = 126, 499 list items = 499, 1 code block = 1, and for every one of the 123 records the list items and paragraphs are equal; quality-bar 8/25/21 = 8/25/21; CLAUDE.md 10/32/27 = 10/32/27; tools/README.md 72/115/77 = 72/115/77; (c) identifiers - met except F2 (scripted per record: AP, REQ, ISS, WF, decisions, Q, R, section signs, numbers, backticked tokens, paths); the only token differences are translated placeholders, decimal comma to point, and glosses that repeat a quoted word; (d) Cyrillic left - met: every Russian passage is a quotation with an English gloss (UI texts, tool output, the four Russian field names of an AP record, role titles in the roles table); not a quotation and not glossed: only the placeholders in L1 and L2; (e) plain English and glossary - met with one slip (L5: 'finish accounting' in AP-073); (f) all 37 role files have 'name: Sai <Role> (CODE)' and src/handoffs/roles.js reads 37 codes. The 37 re-pointed tests: every one checks the same fact in the English text, except the negative part of FS-16 (F1); nothing is deleted or skipped, and nothing is made looser except the small looseness in L4. npm run check: 1898 tests, 1887 pass, 11 fail, exactly the 11 allowed (HO-46, HO-47, HC-RT-1e, LG-10c, SF-6c, SU-10, SU-11, SV-1f, SV-7e, TR-4b, TR-4e); the same 11 fail with the same names in the clone of the base tag, so they are proven not to come from this work. Quality bar: Q1-Q14 and R1-R3 - not changed by this run (the run only translates; no code, no requirement; Q4 met: one check command ran in my own turn; Q5/Q6: tests re-pointed, one guard weaker - F1; Q12: no silent departure from a decision, see I2; Q13: no new error record needed except as in I4; Q14: STATE.md and requirements.yaml lag, see I1 and L6); R1 unchanged (no merge by this gate), R2 and R3 not applicable. Return route: F1 -> TEST-FIXER (rework step of step 06), F2 -> DOC-UPDATER (rework step of the translation of anti-patterns.md); then RELEASE-VALIDATOR again (gate pass 2 of 3) on the files in the tree. The four Medium findings of step 07 and the findings of step 07b are in other scopes and are not repeated here.

findings.where: tools/test/pixel-office-docs.test.js, test FS-16, line 143 (/задач [0-9n]+\/|полоса хода|«завершена»/ must give 0 in the section Pixel Office), line 148 (/«завершена»/ must give 0 in the limits) and the invented sample at lines 163-165
findings.evidence: The negative check guards that the README does not come back to describe three removed screen features: a task counter 'tasks n/m', a progress strip ('полоса хода') and the state 'завершена'. After the translation the regex has only Russian forms, so it can match only a Russian quotation. Run in this turn on a copy of the project in <scratch>/mut07c: I added to the section '## Pixel Office' of tools/README.md the English line 'The page shows a progress bar (a move strip) and a counter "tasks 3/5" with the status «completed» for each task.' and ran node --test test/pixel-office-docs.test.js: 'ok 3 - FS-16 ...', # pass 9, # fail 0 (the guard did not fire). With the same words in Russian ('полоса хода и задач 3/5 со статусом «завершена»') the result is 'not ok 3 - FS-16', # fail 1. So against the English README the guard is blind; decisions/0080 item 6 says a test is never weakened, only re-pointed at the same fact. Step 06 (result.issues I2) already marked this FOR_REVIEW and left only the Russian forms.
findings.fix: Keep the Russian forms and add English forms of the same three facts to both regexes, for example /tasks? [0-9n]+\/|progress (bar|strip)|move strip|«завершена»|«completed»/i, and extend the invented 'old' sample (line 163) with an English variant so the new forms are shown to fire; the real README must still give 0.
findings.return_to: TEST-FIXER, rework step of step 06 (next letter of the step), then RELEASE-VALIDATOR again.
